content: We need to find template that when applied retrosynthetically reproduces the reaction described. The forward reaction: Horner-Wadsworth-Emmons (HWE) forms C=C double bond, breaks C-P and C-O bonds, forms aliphatic carboxylic acid and C-C double bond. The functional groups broken: C-P (phosphonate) and C-O (maybe carbonyl? Actually the C-O of the phosphonate? In HWE, the phosphonate ester (P=O) attached to carbon, and the carbonyl of aldehyde/ketone is broken? Wait forward: aldehyde/ketone + phosphonate carbanion -> alkene + phosphate byproduct. So broken bonds: C-P (phosphonate carbon to phosphorus) and C-O (the carbonyl C=O? Actually carbonyl C=O bond is broken to form C=C). But functional groups broken list expects known groups. We have "aliphatic carboxylic acid" formed, "C-C double bonds" formed. The broken functional groups maybe "phosphonate" not in list. The list includes "trimethylsilyl" etc. So we need to search using functional groups that are available. Perhaps we can search without specifying broken groups, just using formed groups and bonds. Let's try search with functional_groups_formed only.
